tasks.short: Develop production, inventory or quality assurance programs.

steps.what: Verify actual production, inventory and quality records and the program objectives
inputs: actual manufacturing records
actual engineering program objectives and constraints

steps.what: Develop actual production, inventory or quality assurance program methods and exception rules
inputs: technician-checked manufacturing program basis
actual engineering direction
outputs: technician-developed program procedures, parameters and exception rules

steps.what: Assemble program schedules, parameter tables and forms using native manufacturing templates
inputs: technician-developed program procedures, parameters and exception rules
technician-checked manufacturing program basis
outputs: technician-checked complete candidate manufacturing program pack

steps.what: Verify and approve the complete final manufacturing program proposal within actual delegated authority
inputs: technician-checked complete candidate manufacturing program pack

steps.what: Save the approved final manufacturing program proposal
inputs: approved final manufacturing program proposal

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} schedule, parameter and form templates from the technician actual program decisions. The technician checks evidence, develops program methods and verifies the final proposal personally. Approval of the complete final proposal precedes its separate {DOCS} save; production release is not inferred.
tasks.previous_blocker: Human-chosen program parameters may be recopied into schedules and operating forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native manufacturing templates can reuse exact program parameters and source references.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing workable controls and exception rules for actual manufacturing conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The technician understands how a program changes real shop-floor work.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated manufacturing program pack assembly with development judgement retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: manufacturing systems support native schedule and parameter templates; this program assembly is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual schedule and form re-entry after existing native manufacturing templates; existing scheduling and runtime earn no saving.

Actual manufacturing records supply process_id, period, quantity and quality_result. s1 retains full validity checks; s2 captures actual chosen procedure, parameter_value, unit, interval and exception_rule at full time. s3 retains 12.5 hours for form and parameter checks; missing data uses manual assembly.

Final proposal approval follows complete assembly. Changes void approval. Actual engineering sign-off or production release beyond delegated technician authority is not claimed as completed or free work. Same-system save earns no benefit.
research_questions: Which human-chosen parameters are still retyped into program forms and schedules?

incremental.description: Maintain actual program parameter and form mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final manufacturing program proposal

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only pack assembly changes: 25 times 50% = 12.5 less 1 upkeep = 11.5. Low halves that benefit: 6.25 less 1 = 5.25.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop manufacturing technologies that reduce emissions, material impacts or waste.

steps.what: Develop candidate sustainable manufacturing technologies from actual process constraints and environmental objectives
inputs: actual manufacturing process and material records
actual sustainability objectives and engineering direction
outputs: technician-developed sustainable technology candidates and trial requirements

steps.what: Observe or conduct actual authorised manufacturing trials and inspect actual material and waste behaviour
inputs: technician-developed sustainable technology candidates and trial requirements
actual authorised trial conditions
outputs: actual sustainable technology trial observations and instrument readings

steps.what: Capture actual trial quantities, energy, emissions evidence, material changes and waste observations
inputs: actual sustainable technology trial observations and instrument readings
outputs: technician-captured actual trial measurement set with source references

steps.what: Compare actual trial indicators using native test report tables and approved factor mappings
inputs: technician-captured actual trial measurement set with source references
actual approved comparison definitions and factors
outputs: technician-checked trial comparison tables and limitations

steps.what: Evaluate actual technology tradeoffs and approve the complete final development findings record
inputs: technician-checked trial comparison tables and limitations
technician-developed sustainable technology candidates and trial requirements
outputs: approved final sustainable manufacturing development findings and uncertainty

steps.what: Save the approved actual sustainable manufacturing development findings
inputs: approved final sustainable manufacturing development findings and uncertainty

tasks.design: Retain human sustainable technology development and actual trials. Configure native {TEST_DATA_SYSTEM} comparison tables, denoted OTHER with trial instruments, from actual captured values and approved factors. The technician evaluates tradeoffs and approves the complete final findings before separate storage; no emissions saving is invented.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual trial measurements may be repeatedly aligned and converted into comparison tables.
tasks.enabler_now: Native test report templates can reuse exact units, periods and approved comparison factors.
tasks.still_hard: Material substitution tradeoffs, practical process behaviour and valid environmental boundaries.
tasks.human_edge: The technician recognises when an apparent material or emissions improvement creates another problem.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated trial table preparation with sustainable technology judgement retained.

evidence.claim: Test systems can produce data reports; actual sustainability indicator mapping remains proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Observe residual trial table preparation after existing test reports; existing sensor capture and runtime earn no labour saving.

s3 retains full capture of actual trial_id, measured_quantity, unit, period, material_id, source_result_id and observed_limitations. Actual approved comparison owner supplies factor_version and boundary_definition where factors are used. s4 retains 7.5 hours for comparability and factor checks. Missing actual measurements use manual analysis and remain unknown, never invented.

s2 retains actual trial authorisation and physical work; no autonomous process changes occur. s5 retains full tradeoff judgement and final writing. Any changed finding requires renewed approval before save. Same-system save earns no benefit.
research_questions: Which actual trial indicators still require repeated unit and source alignment?

incremental.description: Maintain actual trial indicator and approved factor mappings

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete final actual sustainable manufacturing findings and uncertainty

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only trial comparison preparation changes: 15 times 50% = 7.5 less 1 upkeep = 6.5. Low halves that benefit: 3.75 less 1 = 2.75. No environmental outcome is converted into labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design plant layouts or production facilities.

steps.what: Verify actual plant dimensions, process flows, equipment requirements and layout constraints
inputs: actual plant survey and equipment records
actual process and layout requirements

steps.what: Design actual plant layout or production facility arrangements and evaluate access and flow
inputs: technician-checked plant layout design basis
actual engineering direction
outputs: technician-chosen candidate equipment placements, routes and clearances

steps.what: Prepare detailed layout drawings using native equipment blocks, dimension links and sheet templates
inputs: technician-chosen candidate equipment placements, routes and clearances
actual verified equipment geometry library
outputs: technician-checked complete candidate plant layout drawings

steps.what: Validate and approve the complete final plant layout drawing proposal
inputs: technician-checked complete candidate plant layout drawings
technician-checked plant layout design basis
outputs: approved final plant layout drawing proposal

steps.what: Save the approved final plant layout drawing proposal
inputs: approved final plant layout drawing proposal
outputs: saved final plant layout drawing proposal

tasks.design: Configure native equipment blocks, dimension links and sheet templates in {CAD}, denoted OTHER. The technician verifies the actual design basis and chooses plant arrangements personally; reuse reduces repeated detailed drawing preparation. Full layout validation and final proposal approval precede a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Chosen equipment geometry and dimensions may be repeatedly redrawn across layout sheets.
tasks.enabler_now: Native block libraries and linked dimensions can reuse verified geometry without selecting layouts.
tasks.still_hard: Actual process flow, access, maintenance clearances and safe practical arrangements.
tasks.human_edge: The technician notices when a drawing fits geometrically but will not work on the floor.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated layout drafting with plant arrangement judgement retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: drafting systems support native equipment blocks and linked dimensions; this plant layout configuration is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual redrawing after current CAD libraries; existing blocks, dimensions and runtime earn no benefit.

Actual survey and equipment sources supply coordinate_reference, equipment_id, geometry_version and dimensions. s1 retains full source checks; s2 captures chosen placement, orientation, route and clearance at full time. s3 retains 8 hours for geometry and sheet checks; missing compatible blocks are drafted manually.

s4 retains full practical layout validation and approval within actual delegated proposal authority. Any changed drawing voids approval before save. Same-system save earns no benefit; engineering release and construction are not inferred.
research_questions: Which chosen equipment geometry is still repeatedly drawn after existing CAD blocks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual equipment geometry and drawing template mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final validated plant layout drawing proposal

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only detailed drawing preparation changes: 20 times 60% = 12 less 1 upkeep = 11. Low halves that benefit: 6 less 1 = 5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Human manufacturing program, technology and layout development with less repeated technical assembly.
reach: Engineering sign-off, process release and shop-floor execution retain actual separate authority.
